## Summary

Inkuno is one Rust crate on GPUI 0.2.2 (`ARCHITECTURE.md:11-36`, `Cargo.toml:1-48`). There are **no `[features]` in `Cargo.toml`** — trimming means deleting code + deps, not flipping flags. The bloat is concentrated in 4 compile-heavy dep groups plus 5 large feature subsystems. Nothing was edited, built, or measured — wins below are structural estimates, not profiled numbers.

Heavy-dependency drivers (`Cargo.toml:12-36`): `latex-rust:2.1.0` (`Cargo.toml:16`), `mermaid-rs-renderer:0.3.1` (`Cargo.toml:17`), `resvg:0.45.1` with `text/system-fonts/memmap-fonts` (`Cargo.toml:26`), `svg2pdf:0.13.0` + `pdf-writer:0.12.1` + `ttf-parser:0.25.1` (`Cargo.toml:21,29-31`). Cheap/transitive (keep): `base64, flate2, regex, sha2, serde_json` — already pulled by GPUI at the same version per the comments in `Cargo.toml:12-14,22-24,32-33`. `notify:7` is pinned deliberately (`Cargo.toml:18-20`); keep the watcher.

## Ranked trim-candidate table

Owner approves/rejects per row. Ordered by build-complexity + maintenance win.

| # | Candidate | Where it lives | Recommendation | Blast radius if removed | Rough win | Verify after approval |
|---|-----------|----------------|----------------|------------------------|-----------|----------------------|
| 1 | LaTeX formula rendering | `src/ui/figure.rs:latex()` (~line 80), `src/views/viewer.rs:Source::Formula`, consumers in `src/views/editor/layout.rs:1374` (per `docs/design/markdown_renderer.md:109-132`), `book/src/writing.md:32` | **Trim first** — niche, heavy native-font math stack | Formulas stop rendering (show source or "cannot read"); `figure::latex` unit test in `src/ui/figure.rs` and `feedback.rs:150-172` mermaid/math tests go; MCP has no latex tool so no protocol break | Removes `latex-rust` subtree entirely | `grep -rn "figure::latex\|Source::Formula" src/ book/ && cargo tree -i latex-rust` then `cargo test --locked` |
| 2 | Mermaid *renderer* (keep the canvas-bridge parser optionally) | Renderer: `src/ui/figure.rs:mermaid()` (~line 40) via `mermaid-rs-renderer`; display via `src/views/viewer.rs:Source::Mermaid`; validation via `src/mcp/draw.rs:59-73 check_mermaid`; pure bridge `src/logic/mermaid.rs:1` (1151 lines, `kind`/`to_diagram`) | **Trim renderer, keep-or-trim bridge** — renderer is the dep cost; `logic/mermaid.rs` is pure Rust with no third-party cost | Mermaid fences no longer rasterize (fallback: code block or "open on canvas" only for class/sequence/state via `views/viewer.rs` edit button + `shell/diagrams.rs:209-233 show_figure`); `book/src/diagrams.md:1-10`, `book/src/writing.md` math/mermaid sections, `shell/tests/end_to_end/diagrams.rs`, `src/mcp/draw.rs` check path need updating | Removes `mermaid-rs-renderer` subtree (JS-engine-style crate, plus `catch_unwind` hardening in `figure.rs` becomes dead) | `grep -rn "figure::mermaid\|Source::Mermaid\|check_mermaid" src/ && cargo tree -i mermaid-rs-renderer` |

| 8 | `inkuno mcp` agent server | `src/mcp/` (7 files: `mod,notes,draw,guide,tools,vault,check`), entry branch `src/main.rs:mcp::run()`, door `src/platform/link.rs` + `Shell::listen` (`ARCHITECTURE.md:88`), guide resources cited in `book/src/agents.md:175-213`, `src/mcp/guide.rs:293-302`, tests `src/mcp/*` + pipe session | **Park behind decision** — zero GUI-dep cost (uses `logic/ui/platform` only, `ARCHITECTURE.md:24`), but large API-maintenance surface | Agents lose JSON-RPC stdio access (notes/draw/guide/show); `--help` text (`src/main.rs:help_text`) and `docs/design/*` agent-chat references (`markdown_renderer.md:263-284`, `app-ui.md:530-540`) go stale; GUI untouched | No heavy-dep removal (`base64` PNG stays via gpui anyway); saves review/test burden, not build minutes | `grep -rn "mcp::\|platform::link\|inkuno mcp" src/ book/ docs/ && cargo test --locked mcp` |

## Open questions for the owner

1. Is the canvas diagram editor (+UML + SVG import) the product's moat, or is plain-Markdown speed the moat? Yes → keep #5 and only trim #1–#4 around it. No → #5 is the biggest unbloat.
2. May Mermaid fences degrade to code blocks (drop renderer #2) while keeping `logic/mermaid.rs` → canvas conversion? Or drop the bridge too?
3. Is "Save as PDF" a must (keep #3), or is Markdown-only export acceptable?
4. Is `inkuno mcp` (#8) a supported product or an experiment? Dropping it simplifies `main.rs`, `platform/link.rs`, and agent docs in one move.
5. Git-sync (#9): is the README promise ("sync with git, Syncthing or a cloud folder") sufficient, making in-app sync + auto-update deletable?
6. For #10, which single chrome bothers most — graph, kanban-view, capture, templates, share menu? Rank them and they can go one PR each.
7. Test policy: when a feature is cut, may its `end_to_end` chapter + `book` page + keymap rows be deleted in the same PR (keeps `shortcuts_page_is_current` green)?
